modpackConfirm.title: Install {{title}}?
modpackConfirm.description: This writes the pack's mods and configuration onto the server. The pack is downloaded and unpacked first, so nothing on the server changes until it is known to be usable.
modpackConfirm.backupAvailableHint: A backup is taken before anything is written. If it fails, the install does not start.
modpackConfirm.backupUnavailableHint: Unavailable: this node has no backup storage configured for the server.
modpackConfirm.wipeHint: Clears the current mod jars so the result matches the pack. Turn this off to merge the pack into what is already installed.
modpackConfirm.wipeWarning: Existing mods will be deleted and there is no backup to restore from. Mod configuration shipped with the pack will also overwrite what is on the server.
